publication_type: bilingual unitary-search and Control Room synchronization layer
purpose: Synchronize the existing six-system unitary public shell with post-shell public dossiers and make future same-project specialist-sitemap routes discoverable without changing evidential status.

architecture.search_fallback: Base curated registry + synchronization registry + every same-project sitemap declared in robots.txt

required_search_queries.purpose: generic specialist-sitemap fallback proof independent of the synchronization registry

publication_safety.search: Search results are discovery metadata and do not create, strengthen or adjudicate a factual or legal proposition.
publication_safety.article1535: No assertion that Article 1535 certainly applied or that LPB had a guaranteed winning claim.
publication_safety.dp1041_termination: No assertion that the insolvency administration personally terminated the DP1041 route until the exact primary cessation act and instruction are recovered.
publication_safety.dp1041_intent: No assertion of collusion, corruption or improper judicial bias from the effect pattern alone.
publication_safety.cuatrecasas_complaints: A professional-conduct complaint is an allegation; archive for limitation or territorial competence is not a merits ruling; a pending appeal does not predict success.
publication_safety.privilege: No privileged Cuatrecasas advice or confidential lawyer-client material is reproduced by this synchronization layer.
publication_safety.six_system_boundary: No new top-level case system is created; new public dossiers are bridged into the existing architecture.

required_controls: exactly six Control Room system cards in both languages
DP1041/retracto link visible in each Control Room
Cuatrecasas lifecycle and ICAM/CCACM links visible in each Control Room
CEXP, DP1041, Cuatrecasas and PwC specialist-sitemap searches resolve
no page-level horizontal overflow on tested routes
new routes and gateways retain the global Case/Search utility

live_verification.note: Merge and production-subpath browser rendering do not by themselves establish independent public-edge LIVE_VERIFIED status.
